- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

A checkpoint resume needs to restore the training progress that was saved. With `restore_training_state=True`, this change loads the Bridge-compatible `train_state.pt` sidecar into the active Megatron-LM `TrainState`, including iteration, consumed and skipped samples, validation samples, accumulated FLOPs, and train/valid/test flags. Inference loading does not adopt training progress.

For example, if the sidecar records iteration 321 while the legacy checkpoint records iteration 123, resume uses 321. Without a sidecar, it reconstructs the active state from the legacy checkpoint fields. The restored values are also copied to `args` while the training-loop migration continues. Legacy distributed-optimizer loading uses the original checkpoint directory without overwriting the restored training iteration.

The save path uses the sidecar writer already on `main`. It snapshots progress before async finalization, and the iteration sidecar and `latest_train_state.pt` tracker receive the same values. Rank zero decides whether the sidecar exists and broadcasts the state or the legacy-fallback decision, so ranks enter the same collective path. FLOP counts retain the upstream `float64` representation, including values above the `int64` limit.

## Issue tracking

Fixes #6004

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel, I have added its bit-exact determinism test and registered it in `tests/unit_tests/determinism/kernels/manifest.py` (not applicable)
- [x] I have added proper typing to my code [Typing guidelines](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html)
- [x] I have added relevant documentation
- [x] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

### Validation

- Rebased onto `main` at `3140ce462` and preserved its explicit `restore_training_state` contract. Training resume with `restore_training_state=True` adopts sidecar progress; inference loading keeps the legacy checkpoint metadata and does not read the sidecar or access active training state. The checkpoint test covers default, explicit inference, and explicit resume loads, plus legacy fallback.
- Six CPU training-state tests and two save-time snapshot checks passed. A real two-rank Gloo run passed sidecar restoration, uniform missing-file fallback with different rank-local paths, and corrupt-file error broadcast.
- Eight checks of isolated production restoration blocks passed across inference/resume, sidecar/fallback, and iteration override inputs. The same acceptance assertions failed on base `3140ce462`, which does not restore active training state. These checks do not execute the full checkpoint loader.
- Regression inputs with sidecar iteration 321 and tracker iteration 0 or 123 preserved 321 and the original optimizer checkpoint location. The model-save assertion passed with sidecar serialization following it.
- `BASE_REF=main CHECK_ONLY=true SKIP_DOCS=false bash tools/autoformat.sh` passed Black, isort, pylint, Ruff, and mypy for both changed test files. `uv run --no-sync isort tests/unit_tests/test_checkpointing.py megatron/training/checkpointing.py` and `git diff --check` passed.

`uv run --no-sync python -m torch.distributed.run --nproc-per-node 8 -m pytest -q tests/unit_tests/test_checkpointing.py -k 'test_save_checkpoint or test_load_checkpoint or test_checkpoint_load_without_microbatch_calculator'` stopped during conftest collection because Triton is unavailable. This macOS host has no CUDA devices. GPU checkpoint save/load, NVIDIA collectives, and actual async finalization remain unverified locally. CPU storage helpers, isolated production blocks, and Gloo collectives do not replace full checkpoint integration. Hosted validation and human review remain required. The author line-review checkbox remains open for personal review of this revision.

### Code review

Expert and final review follow the project workflow. This PR is already non-draft; current-head hosted validation and human review remain required.

### Merge

Merge follows the repository's required checks and reviews.

+# Copyright (c) 2026, NVIDIA CORPORATION. All rights reserved.
+
+"""Tests for the Bridge-compatible Megatron-LM training state."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from megatron.training.state import TrainState, load_train_state, save_train_state
+
+
+def test_train_state_matches_bridge_schema():
+    args = SimpleNamespace(
+        consumed_train_samples=11,
+        skipped_train_samples=12,
+        consumed_valid_samples=13,
+        do_train=True,
+        do_valid=False,
+        do_test=True,
+    )
+
+    train_state = TrainState()
+    train_state.update_from_args(args, iteration=14, num_floating_point_operations_so_far=15)
+    state_dict = train_state.state_dict()
+
+    assert set(state_dict) == {
+        "step",
+        "consumed_train_samples",
+        "skipped_train_samples",
+        "consumed_valid_samples",
+        "floating_point_operations_so_far",
+        "do_train",
+        "do_valid",
+        "do_test",
+    }
+    assert state_dict["step"].dtype == torch.int64
+    assert state_dict["consumed_train_samples"].dtype == torch.int64
+    assert state_dict["skipped_train_samples"].dtype == torch.int64
+    assert state_dict["consumed_valid_samples"].dtype == torch.int64
+    assert state_dict["floating_point_operations_so_far"].dtype == torch.float64
+    assert state_dict["do_train"].dtype == torch.bool
+    assert state_dict["do_valid"].dtype == torch.bool
+    assert state_dict["do_test"].dtype == torch.bool
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("flops", [25, 2**64])
+def test_train_state_save_load_and_apply(tmp_path, flops):
+    expected = TrainState(
+        iteration=21,
+        consumed_train_samples=22,
+        skipped_train_samples=23,
+        consumed_valid_samples=24,
+        num_floating_point_operations_so_far=flops,
+        do_train=True,
+        do_valid=True,
+        do_test=False,
+    )
+    filename = tmp_path / "train_state.pt"
+
+    save_train_state(expected, filename)
+    actual = load_train_state(filename)
+    args = SimpleNamespace()
+    actual.apply_to_args(args)
+
+    assert actual == expected
+    assert isinstance(actual.num_floating_point_operations_so_far, int)
+    assert args.consumed_train_samples == 22
+    assert args.skipped_train_samples == 23
+    assert args.consumed_valid_samples == 24
+    assert args.do_train is True
+    assert args.do_valid is True
+    assert args.do_test is False
+
+
+def test_missing_train_state_falls_back_only_when_allowed(tmp_path):
+    filename = tmp_path / "train_state.pt"
+    assert load_train_state(filename, missing_ok=True) is None
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="Unable to load train state file"):
+        load_train_state(filename)
+
+
+def test_corrupt_train_state_does_not_fall_back(tmp_path):
+    filename = tmp_path / "train_state.pt"
+    filename.write_bytes(b"invalid checkpoint")
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="Unable to load train state file"):
+        load_train_state(filename, missing_ok=True)
+
+
+def test_nonzero_rank_uses_broadcast_presence_decision(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "is_initialized", lambda: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "get_rank", lambda: 1)
+
+    def missing_sidecar(objects, src):
+        assert src == 0
+        objects[0] = {"state_dict": None}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "broadcast_object_list", missing_sidecar)
+    assert load_train_state(tmp_path / "train_state.pt", missing_ok=True) is None
